name: 20261031-ppo-small-paper300
rollout_storage: lossless packed RAM: float32 numerics, packed binary flags, uint16 card IDs

paper_alignment.iterations: 300, changed by user request after 3 completed iterations; per-iteration decision budget stays 4,194,304
paper_alignment.undisclosed_early_training_details: LR endpoints, minibatch/epochs and several PPO coefficients borrowed from final-stage Table 7; linear schedule is a local choice
paper_alignment.opponents: seven identical built-in scripted bots; original calibrated libraries not reproduced
paper_alignment.local_turn_budget: 60 operations per turn to prevent infinite free-action loops; not specified in paper
paper_alignment.learning_rate_history: First 3 iterations used the 400-iteration linear schedule; from iteration 4 onward use the 300-iteration schedule.

evaluation_policy: stochastic, fixed evaluation seed, isolated from training RNG
